profile.headline: Senior Sofware Engineer at Wells Fargo
profile.summary: Recent JUMP graduate pursuing a Java Development career, looking to combine nearly 18 months of industry equivalent experience with a strong digital mindset to become a valued asset to your organization. University of Florida Computer Science Alumni.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Full-Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
Cognixia’s JUMP program is a hyper-intense technical training program that gives top STEM talent from across the U.S. the equivalent of 12-18 months of industry experience. Not only do they up-skill their technical abilities, they also evolve their digital mindset to successfully adapt and utilize technology in an efficient manner so they can JUMP start their careers via deployment with Collabera clients.	
-Design Flexibility – experience with DAO and DTO design patterns, JDBC, JPA and Hibernate for interfacing with Data Persistence
-Collaborative Development – used Git CLI and GitHub under AGILE Methodology with teammates to develop a Full Stack Application
-Database Proficiency - in RDBMS MySQL as well as NoSQL with MongoDB.

volunteerExperiences.description: Looked after 1st and 2nd grade students after school and helped with them with their homework .
